name: IELTS Speak
tagline: IELTS speaking practice with timers on your glasses
description: Photograph an IELTS speaking topic, get Part 1/2/3 questions on your G2 display, and answer against real exam timers.
author: IELTS Speak

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends topic photos and transcripts to the Claude API, and streams your recorded answers to Soniox for live transcription.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Takes a photo of the speaking topic or cue card.

permissions.name: album
permissions.desc: Picks an existing photo of a speaking topic.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records your spoken answers so you can play them back.
